Two questions for every discovery call
Lena wants to know who she's talking to before Northwind's discovery calls. Follow her questions from the Booking form tab to Clara's answers in her inbox.
Booking form
Start from the questions every booking asks
Lena opens the discovery call's Booking form tab. Name and email are required, and the rest can be optional or hidden, so she switches Add guests off.
Add question
Add a dropdown and a free-text question
She adds Company size as a Select with four sizes and keeps it required. A required long-text question, What would you like to discuss?, goes in under it.
Booking page
Clara answers as she books
After picking Thursday at 11:00am, Clara gets Lena's questions on the form. Both carry a *, so she answers them before she confirms.
Booking confirmed
The answers arrive with the booking
Clara's confirmation lists what she wrote, and Lena's email ends with the same answers. Lena knows the team's size and the topic before she joins.

Questions about booking questions
Which questions you can ask, and where the answers go.
Ask a question
What are booking questions?
The fields on an event type's booking form. Every event starts with name, email and a few more, and you can add your own on the Booking form tab. Bookers answer them before they confirm.
Which input types can I use?
Short Text, Long Text, Number, Select, MultiSelect, Checkbox Group, Radio Group, Checkbox, Phone, Email, Address, Multiple Emails and URL. Long Text can set a minimum and maximum length, and on a paid event the options of a Select or a group can add to the price.
Can I change the default questions?
Mostly. Your name is always required, though you can split it into first and last name. Email, phone, additional notes, guests and the others can be made optional or hidden. You can delete only the questions you added.
Where do the answers go?
Onto the booking: the booker's confirmation page lists them, they're in the host's booking emails, and they're added to the calendar event's description.
Can a link fill in the answers?
Yes. Each question has an identifier, and adding it to the booking link as a URL parameter, like &name=john, fills that question in. You can also lock a question once the link has filled it.
What does hiding a question do?
It takes the question off the booking page without deleting it, so you can switch it back on later. If a link fills in a hidden question, the answer still reaches the host, and only the host's emails show it.
